title: An owner with no credits who asks MettleUp for more is sent back to the AI Assistant
what: The AI credits sheet tells the owner to write to MettleUp in Help and feedback. When the gym has no credits left, the message sent there gets a help-page answer saying the gym has no credits and to get more from the AI Assistant, with an Open AI Assistant button. The owner goes round in a circle; only a small last line says the team reads every message.
expected: A credit request written in Help and feedback says plainly that MettleUp got it and will add the credits, with no button back to where the owner started.
how_often: every time an owner with no credits asks for more
fix_line: When the help box has no credits to answer, say the request reached MettleUp and drop the button back to the AI Assistant

title: The week summary's main button promises to send it to the owner's WhatsApp, but nothing can
what: The week summary answer card has one big button, Send this to my WhatsApp. It only asks the AI that sentence again. The AI's list of tasks has no way to send anything to the owner's own WhatsApp, so at best the owner gets a 'cannot do' card, and the tap may use one of the day's questions.
expected: Only buttons that work are shown: either the summary really goes to the owner's WhatsApp, or the button is not there.
how_often: every time the week summary is asked
fix_line: Remove the Send this to my WhatsApp button until sending to the owner is built

title: A how-to question is sent to Help and feedback empty, where asking again may cost credits
what: When the owner asks the AI Assistant how to do something, or asks for something it cannot do, the card offers Open Help and feedback. The owner's question is not carried over, so he must type it again. In Help and feedback a question is paid from the gym's AI credits, while the owner's own questions in the AI Assistant are free.
expected: The question goes with the owner to Help and feedback already filled in, and moving it there costs nothing extra.
fix_line: Open Help and feedback with the owner's question already in the box

title: If the AI key goes missing, or one usage table cannot be read, the AI Assistant quietly disappears for every owner
what: The server answers 'switched off' when the AI key is not set, and also when a usage table cannot be read. The admin app then hides the AI Assistant with no word to the owner. A missing key is not even logged, so nobody at MettleUp is told. The assistant also borrows the help box's key when its own is missing, so one lost key can stop both.
expected: A missing or expired key, or a database problem, raises an alert to MettleUp, and the owner sees a short 'not working right now' line instead of the feature vanishing.
how_often: whenever a key is removed, expires or the table read fails
fix_line: Keep 'switched off' for the planned switch only; log and alert on a missing key or table error and show the owner a calm problem line

title: Every AI credit top-up is a hand job hidden among ordinary help messages
what: Buying credits in the admin app is not built. The owner writes a free-text message in Help and feedback and MettleUp must spot it among all other help messages and add credits by hand on the HQ page. The message carries no mark that it is a credit request, and nothing reminds MettleUp it is waiting.
expected: A credit request reaches MettleUp marked as one, with the amount asked, so it cannot be missed on a busy day.
fix_line: Send credit requests as their own marked kind of message, with the number of credits

title: The AI Assistant help page leaves out the daily question limit and how to get credits
what: The help page says questions are free and the credits show at the top. It never says there is a daily number of questions after which the ask box locks until tomorrow, and never says how to get more credits (write to MettleUp). An owner who hits either has no help page that explains it.
expected: The help page names the daily question limit and says how to get more credits.
how_often: when an owner hits the limit or runs out
fix_line: Add two lines to the AI Assistant help page: the daily limit and how to get credits
